#Ewha Womans University #Daehyun-dong #Amazing Work

“The main menu of this house is space”

There are rooms in Sinchon and Ewha University areas, and there are no more high-end, concept Chinese restaurants anymore.
After the closure of Yonsei Alumni Center, formerly operated by Our Home and operated by Hanwha of Ewha Womans University ECC, there are no Chinese restaurants of this type.
However, a new Chinese restaurant opened on the street of Ewha Womans University, on the 10th floor of a new building, and it has exactly that concept.

There is no taste.
The Jjambbong is also terribly formal and the Jjajang is average.
Instead, the fried egg was good, and the fried rice wasn't as expensive as it used to be, but it wasn't bad.
Many of the dishes are not at a level worth recommending, but they are better than average to be dismissed as tasteless.

In summary, a new restaurant has been opened that is more functional than tasty.
This is a dish for gatherings made from a set recipe by a mass-produced cook who has practiced using a wok at an academy rather than a chef who worries about taste.

Food is not the main focus...
This is a restaurant where space is the main focus.

#Sinchon #Changcheon-dong #Wan Chai

"Rich and spicy Chinese food"

During my last visit a few years ago, looking at the bowl of watery Ganjjajang noodles, I thought I shouldn't come to this place.
However, since Hwasangson Dumpling disappeared from Sinchon, there are no Chinese restaurants where you can enjoy a decent meal, so Wan Chai is bound to be the best place for gatherings.

This is a representative long-established Chinese restaurant in Sinchon run by a Taiwanese chef who advocates spicy Chinese food.
It looks like Korean-style Chinese food, but the taste is clearly different.

Spicy Chinese food may have been introduced as a result of the very spicy mussel dish becoming famous, but since the menu includes this, there are quite a few spicy dishes on the menu.
However, one thing that is disappointing is that even foods that are not supposed to be spicy are spicy.
In particular, the menu items such as lambjangpi, which I ordered as an appetizer, used too much pepper in the stir-fry, so it was too irritating to the tongue, and the spiciness of the kkanpunggi that followed was added, making it more memorable for the spiciness than the taste.

Fortunately, the sweet and sour pork is still delicious and the fries are great, so the basics are solid and the flavor is good.

The Ganjjajang (ganjjajang), which was disappointing in the past, was very good this time, and since we only ordered a few bowls for a group, I was thankful that they cut the noodles with scissors to make it easier to share.

Wan Chai becomes better again

reviews.author: Because he’s a genius
reviews.text:
This place is literally close to “a place to eat memories.”
While living around here, I went to one Chinese restaurant after another, and this one was the most ‘adgressive’ among them.
To conclude, today is also very stimulating.
However, if you think that Chinese food is meant to be enjoyed for its taste, it can be enjoyed within an acceptable range.

The first edition is mussels (30,000).
I remember the name used to be ‘Very Spicy Hong Kong Mussels’, but as the name became milder, the taste also became slightly milder.
It's not spicy enough to make you cough like it used to be, but now it's like, 'Oh, it's spicy.'
So, while I think the two of us finished the game together, it's a shame that the charm of the extreme was missing somewhere.

Still, I passed the basics as the scent of the sea was clear and there was no fishy smell.
However, this is for at least 4 people.
It's a strong menu, so if you keep eating it, you'll automatically miss sweet and sour pork.

Followed by Tray Jjajang (20,000).
As soon as I ordered it, I said “oops”.
There is red pepper oil at the bottom and it is red in color.

As I sucked in the first chopstick, the tip of my nose tingled to the point of making me sneeze.
Still, it's not so spicy that I can't eat it because the sweetness at the bottom supports it.
The vegetables and shrimp had a good spicy taste, but the quality of the shrimp itself was not very good.

There is a time when noodles need to be slightly soaked before eating.
The best time is when the seasoning starts to set, but if you miss that golden time, the noodles will turn into rice cakes and the amount will double, so be careful.

Ultimately, in this house, satisfaction increases when you enjoy the rhythm of stimulation that pushes you “strong, strong, strong.”
Start with mussels, have sweet and sour pork (or a less spicy dish) on the side, and finish with Jjajang (jjajang) at the end—the best way is to gather a large number of people and enjoy the meal.
On days when you are looking for a mild taste or when you want to eat alone and quietly, other alternatives are better.

reviews.author: YennaPPa (Luscious.K)
reviews.text:
#Ewha Womans University #Daehyeon-dong #U

“A Chinese restaurant in front of Ewha Womans University that transformed from a boulder into a jewel.”

It's already been 6 years since I last had a meal in front of Ewha Womans University.
At that time, I was very disappointed with the taste, so I did not visit anymore, but in the meantime, the place also moved once.
People's tastes and appetites are so treacherous that there suddenly came a time when I wanted to eat Yu-don's rice bowl.
On a chilly winter night, Chinese rice bowl with rich and spicy sauce suddenly...

In fact, Yu has been famous in front of Ewha Womans University as a restaurant that serves rice bowls well.
Rather than Jjajang and Jjamppong, there are about 9 types of rice bowl menu, including Palbochae, Yusanseul, and Rajogi Rice Bowl.
On this day, I really wanted to eat Rajoyuk Rice Bowl, so I asked for it.

#Lajoyuk rice bowl
Since you can clearly see the kitchen from your seat, you can clearly see the pork being coated in starch and fried as soon as you order, and the vegetables being stir-fried in another wok to make the sauce.
The sight of making the sauce and finally adding the fries made my mouth water, but when I received the meal, the slightly spicy scent and the fragrant scent of sesame oil coexisted.
The sauce is seasoned with bean paste and red pepper oil, but the savory flavor of the sauce is more dominant than the taste of the seasoning than expected.
I quite like it.
I took a bite of the fried meat and found that the fries were also very good.
The thick meat is lightly seasoned to give it a meaty flavor and deep-fried in a starch batter, the chewy batter combines with the spiciness to create a savory and soft spicy taste.
It's been a long time since I tasted delicious Rajo meat rice with 7 kinds of freshly stir-fried crunchy vegetables.

The fried meat at this place is really good.
In addition, the colorful texture of 7 types of vegetables, including carrots, bamboo shoots, cabbage, onions, shiitake mushrooms, button mushrooms, and wood ear mushrooms, is added, so honestly, it is not a waste of money at 9,000 won and is actually a benefit.
The food here is really good. It may be that my taste buds have changed compared to 6 years ago, but the fact that the flavor has become milder and richer may also be the reason why it has become more delicious.

I visited again a few days ago and tried various menu items, and they were all of high quality.

#Samseonganjjajang
It can be said that Samseonganjjajang is the best in front of Ewha Womans University.
The thickly used chunjang creates a salty and bright soybean paste, and the appropriate level of sugar and seasoning brings out the taste of the soybean paste.
The texture of the onions and cabbage is a bit soft due to the long-term stir-frying, but this is the only place in Sinchon where you can get this level of soybean paste.
It is a truly surprising discovery and a rediscovery of Burns Chinese Restaurant after the recent Ganjajang explosion in Wan Chai.

#unijjajang
I am so amazed by the taste of soybean paste that I fall in love with it.
Surprisingly, because of how well the Uni Jjajang base was stir-fried, the Uni Jjajang is basically given a mild fiery flavor.
The thick taste of chunjang adds depth to the overall jjajang, and the mild sweetness and seasoning add elegance to the food.
With the addition of the soft noodles, it has a surprisingly rich taste that ranks among the few Unijjajangs I've ever had.

#Jjambbong
The rice bowls and jjajang are all delicious, so now it’s time for the jjamppong.
As expected, the Samseon Jjamppong, which is stir-fried with lots of vegetables and seafood right after ordering, is also very delicious.
Jjamppong, which is flavored only with vegetables and seafood and no meat, is not too spicy but balances the taste of well-fried oil, vegetables, and seafood.
A variety of vegetables are used, including cabbage, Chinese cabbage onions, bamboo shoots, carrots, shiitake mushrooms, button mushrooms, and wood ear mushrooms.
Seafood also includes cuttlefish, giant squid, conches, octopus, shrimp, and mussels, allowing eaters to feel the abundance of ingredients.
For a price of 8,000 won, the quality is absolutely outstanding.

#Baekjjamppong
Baek Jjamppong is this restaurant’s signature menu.
Baekjjamppong in other places emphasizes spiciness by adding red pepper, but this restaurant's noodles are light and made with only vegetables, seafood, and chicken broth.
It tastes similar to the Paljintangmyeon sold in hotels or high-end Chinese restaurants.
Usually, hotels sell Paljintangmyeon for 30,000-40,000 won, but at Yu, you can taste it for 8,000 won, so what a blessing.
The sweetness and savory taste of the large amount of vegetables and seafood combine with the chicken broth to create an amazing harmony.
Those who want a slightly stronger taste may want to sprinkle some pepper on it, but I like it better as is.
A party of crunchy cabbage and chewy seafood!!!#Seafood fried rice
It is fragrant fried rice.
It is fried rice with sliced ​​pork, squid, shrimp, and mussels.
The eggs were pre-fried using a burn method, then the rice was added and stir-fried thoroughly. The soy sauce seasoning and pepper aroma were good, and the aroma of the mussels was impressive.
People who like fried rice that flies around might not like it because the rice is quite soft, but I quite like it.
I added a fried egg for an additional 1,000 won, and it felt good and satisfying.

#Yusan Seuldeopbap
I wanted to taste this restaurant's Yusanseul, so I tried Yusanseul rice bowl.
The slices are cut into fairly large chunks, so the taste is quite rich.
The seafood has a lot of fish in it, so it feels really good haha.
Here, squid was sliced and pork was also used.
The texture is okay, but the squid is a bit tough.
The taste is slightly spicy based on oyster sauce.
It was pretty delicious so I ate it all up, but if you like spicy food, adding chili oil is the way to go.

#Seafood Nureungji
The seafood is plentiful, the vegetables are plentiful, and the texture and savory flavor of nureungji are good, but the taste overlaps with Yusanseul.
A menu full of abundance.
It's especially chewy, something that isn't included in other seafood menus here.
It's meal size so it's good for a light meal during a drinking party.

#Rajogi rice bowl
The reason I started visiting the menu here was the Rajogi rice bowl, so I was curious about Rajogi rice bowl as well.
The appearance and taste are similar, but the fries are a bit different. I like the softness that comes from chicken.
Instead, the batter is thick, so there may be some opinions about this part.
It is a delicious rice bowl with plenty of ingredients, sauce, and savory doubanjang.
However, the fried chicken smelled a little oily, so I don't know if it was time to change the oil, or if it was the unique smell of the Rajogi.
If the fried food smells like this on my next visit, I'll have to actively tell them.

#Seafood stir-fried noodles
Unexpectedly, it is fried noodles with oyster sauce and soy sauce base.
It contains sliced ​​pork, shrimp, squid, and mussels, and is also stir-fried with sliced ​​vegetables.
It feels like a Korean-style Romien.
Sprinkling on chili oil increases the flavor even more.

#JapchaeBap
It's a little disappointing than I thought
The first bite was delicious because I liked the strong soy sauce aroma, flavor, and fire, but the sweetness was so strong that the more I ate it, the more it became annoying.
It tends to feel a bit greasy at the end. Might be good for those who like sweet things...

#Grilled dumplings
This is a Chinese restaurant that makes its own dumplings.
In particular, it is made by mixing glutinous rice powder into the dumpling skin, giving the dumpling skin a crispy texture.
The dumpling skin is not too thick, so it is closer to Korean-style dumplings than Chinese dumplings. The light filling is comfortable and the crispy skin has a good texture.
Even though there was a lot of chives in it, the chive flavor was a bit disappointing, but it was a very decent and neat fried dumpling.

I think I've tried almost everything on this restaurant's menu now.
The conclusion is that this house has its own distinct characteristics.
The keynote of taste and ingredients are clear characteristics of Ryu.
Although some dishes taste similar, there are quite a few dishes that are of high quality.

If there are any regrets, they are very minor.
The areas where the flavors of dishes seasoned with oyster sauce overlap - yusanseul, palbochae, seafood nureungjitang, etc.
Because the use of starch is small, the donburi-like sauce is a bit thin - so it spreads like water too quickly (depending on the individual's oral amylase activity)
Well... it's a very minor part, so I'll write it down as a reference for those who go.

PS: He originally operated in Yeonnam-dong and then moved to Yeonhui-dong, but the owner became physically injured from the hard work of the wok, so he came to Ewha Womans University. However, it was very difficult at that location, and when the lease contract ended, the store was moved to a smaller, corner corner of an alley, which is its current location.
He is truly a person who makes delicious food. I hope you take care of your health and that your family business goes well in the future. I should go often too.

reviews.author: Minhan Cho
reviews.text:
It's a good place if you don't need anything else and just want to eat lamb skewers and drink alone.

It costs 10,000 won for 6 skewers (3 skewers can cost 5,000 won if you order additionally). Compared to other lamb skewer restaurants, the price per unit is a little more expensive (about 15,000 or 16,000 won for 10 skewers as of the end of 2022), but considering the price that the owner grills it himself and the fact that there are not many stores that offer lamb skewers for drinking alone, it is worth accepting as a slight premium.

You can choose between mild, medium, and spicy flavors for lamb skewers, and the spiciness varies depending on how much spicy red pepper powder you sprinkle on while grilling. As someone who likes spicy food, I choose the medium flavor, and I think it's okay because it masks the greasiness. Once the owner has finished cooking the food, he puts it on a small brazier provided for each table, so it doesn't cool down until the end. It almost doesn't smell like sheep (which is a shame for me who likes the smell of sheep), and it's soft and greasy. If you pair it with beer, you can have two sets in one sitting. I've also tried lamb ribs, but the regular lamb skewers are softer, so that's all I eat.

There are several other meal menus, among which I tried lamb and green onion ramen, corn noodles, and fried rice. Other than the fried rice, it is best not to expect much. The green onion ramen tastes like well-boiled sari gomtang + seasoned green onion + lamb skewers, and the whole noodles are too oily. The fried rice was stir-fried well, but the portion was a bit small.

In addition, there is kebab, and looking at the Naver review, it seems to be a menu promoted by the owner, but I haven't tried it. Oh, some people might find it uncomfortable because the bathroom is a toilet.

reviews.author: Yum nya yum
reviews.text:
It’s a Vietnamese restaurant in Sinchon.
If you place an order according to the number of people, they provide banh xeo as a service. The banh xeo is crispy and savory, so it goes well with it when wrapped in Vietnamese spring roll and eaten with chili sauce.
I ordered beef tripe rice noodles and beef rice noodles and received the entire menu within 13 minutes.
I think it came out quickly because it wasn't a busy time.
First of all, you order using a tablet, and the banh xeo comes out automatically, so you don't have to order.

▶️Beef tripe rice noodles
I ordered Shin Ramyun Spicy because it didn't have a bad smell and was spicy. If you like spicy food, you can adjust it to make it spicier, so you can order it. Also, the tripe inside went well with the rice noodles.
▶️Beef rice noodles
It's a typical rice noodle dish. The disappointing thing is that the soup is a bit cloudy rather than the clear soup I like. Still, it didn't bother me too much, so I ate it well. The noodles were cooked well, and the beef inside was soft and had a nice chew to it.

▶️The banh xeo that was served was a bit thick and felt a bit greasy, but it wasn't on the outside and the center part was less so so I just wrapped it there and ate it. The amount of meat and bean sprouts inside looked good.

Since there is a tablet, there seems to be almost no delay or omission of orders or requests, and the staff also served and responded quickly, which was nice. The store is a little small and crowded, but I think I'll visit again.

reviews.author: Seungwook Jeong
reviews.text:

The menu price is a bit expensive, around 14,000 won, but the noodles and broth are constantly refilled and banh xeo is provided, so I don't think it's bad.
The rice noodle broth is mostly bone broth. You can think of it as beef bone rice noodles. There is a lot of meat in it and it is soft. The king ribs are a bit greasy, but you can eat them well. It spreads well if you hold the bone and cut it straight with a spoon.
The banh xeo is spicy. The ingredients are simple and it contains pineapple, but it would have been better if it had been sliced thinner.
It is delicious when mixed with peanut sauce and fish sauce and eaten together.
Ice cream can be taken conscientiously after a receipt event.

reviews.author: Jihyeon Hwang
reviews.text:
This is a really satisfying place when I want to eat Thai food in Sinchon.
It's close to Sinchon Station, so it has good accessibility, and most of all, parking is available and it's free for one hour, so it's nice that you don't have to worry about coming by car. There are many people who hesitate in Sinchon because of parking, but I already liked this part.

This time I ordered Pad Thai Goong, Tom Yum Rice Noodles, and Pineapple Fried Rice, and all three dishes exceeded my expectations.
The Pad Thai Goong noodles were stir-fried just right and the sauce wasn't too much, so I was able to enjoy it until the end. There was a large amount of shrimp, so it had a good texture, and the unique flavor of Thai food was still there, but not overpowering.

The Tom Yum rice noodles had a really impressive broth. It has a good balance of sour and spicy flavors, so I couldn't stop eating it as soon as I took a spoonful. The spices are not strong, so I think even people who are not familiar with Thai food can enjoy it.

Pineapple fried rice was a great combination of sweet pineapple and fluffy fried rice, and it was not spicy, so it was enjoyed by people of all ages. I thought it was a really good idea to order together.

And what I remember most is the kindness of the owner. Even though it was my first time visiting, they were very friendly from menu explanation to reception, so I felt good throughout the meal. I think this is a place that makes you want to come back again and again, not only because of the taste.

Overall, I was satisfied with the food, atmosphere, service, and parking, so I plan to visit again when I want Thai food in Sinchon.
I would like to confidently recommend it to anyone looking for Thai cuisine near Sinchon Station.

Ewha Womans University Restaurant!! If you like rice noodles, go there!!
I've been to many pho restaurants, but the pho here is good.👍🏻

First of all, the store is much larger and more comfortable than expected.
It was very comfortable to eat, and the staff were friendly, so I had a pleasant meal overall, from ordering to seating instructions.

The menu I ate was meat-filled rice noodles and Hanoi original fire-fired rice noodles, both menus 👍🏻👍🏻
As the name suggests, Meat Plenty is full of meat.
The meat itself is thin and soft, so when you eat it with the soup, the flavor really comes to life, and the soup is hot, deep, and full of flavor, which is great for this season.

Fire-fired rice noodles have a subtle fire aroma, which is their real charm!! It has a non-irritating, fiery flavor that enhances the flavor of the soup, and the more you eat it, the more addicted you become to it, making you want to eat it again.

When you take a bite of the 3 pieces of nem ordered on the side, they are crispy on the outside and moist and juicy on the inside. It was perfect to eat between rice noodles and the sauce was refreshing and delicious.

Overall, I was satisfied with the taste, atmosphere, and service, and I immediately understood why it was so popular at Ewha Womans University. 100% intention to revisit! If you like rice noodles, be sure to go.

Visit April 2024

reviews.author: Hwanhwan
reviews.text:
Ragu Restaurant.

I like the concise menu.
The bowl salad comes drizzled with balsamic and olive oil. The cheese looks like a type of ricotta cheese.
Ragu pasta contains basil in addition to ragu sauce, so it tastes good as is. The pasta was cooked just a little over al dente, so it didn't spread and was just right.
The lasagna is topped with parsley as a decoration. The sauce is similar to ragu sauce. Since it contains cheese, it is of course delicious if you eat it before it cools down.
Baguette bread is good for mopping up the remaining ragu sauce with a garlic baguette.
Wine is good, but I think pairing it with Sangria is also a good choice.
Overall, I didn't get the impression that the taste itself was very good, but it's not a place that can't cook.

I personally felt good about the restaurant and the simple menu.
I hope there will be more pasta restaurants like Ragu Restaurant that offer good value for money and are simple without being pretentious.

Intention to revisit) Average

I wanted pizza

There are quite a few pizza places in Sinchon.
I searched on the Internet, looked at photos, picked the place I liked the most, and it was here.

reviews.author: YJ Oh
reviews.text: A taproom at a local microbrewery located in Sinchon. AleCrew is a relatively new beer brewery that started in Seongsan-dong in 2020, and is said to have its main branch in Hongdae. You can find it by walking 7 to 8 minutes from Sinchon Subway Station in the direction of Yonsei University. The three-story stand-alone building, which looks like a renovated home, is quite nice, and all floors are run as stores, so it is large in size. If you go up to the second floor through the stairs on the right, there are outdoor tables and seats on the left. When you enter the entrance, there is a counter, and if you go up one floor, there is the main hall. If you order through the tablet installed at each table, the staff will bring you beer and food. As the company name suggests, it mainly specializes in producing ale beer, especially IPA, and there are quite a few different types of NEIPA. They also offer a variety of snacks such as pizza and French fries. Personally, I am a bit disappointed because the taste of NEIPA seems to be less than expected. American Blue IPA is pretty good. The pizza is big and delicious. Various types of wine are also sold. The facilities are very nicely decorated, but I personally think that the taste of the beer and the high prices are something that makes people hesitate to visit.

The combination of the cheese and arugula topping is really good, and the baking is crispy yet soft, so it tastes like an expert skill. Truffle-flavored French fries are perfect with ale beer. And even the salty stir-fried Thai chicken makes this a place you just have to come for a beer. There is a reason why it is famous as a beer restaurant in Sinchon, with its enormous scale and great atmosphere that uses up an entire building.
